item.title: Lions cruise to Birmingham victory
item.description: Millwall were 3-0 winners over Birmingham City in the Sky Bet Championship on Wednesday night. Goals from Femi Azeez, Tristan Crama and Jake Cooper eased The Lions to three points in SE16, with the game wrapped up before The Blues were sent down to 10 men following Jhon Solis' second yellow card. item.title: Alex Neil's reaction to midweek test
item.description: Alex Neil praised his side following Wednesday night's 3-0 Sky Bet Championship victory over Birmingham City at The Den. Femi Azeez, Tristan Crama and Jake Cooper were on target as The Lions cruised to victory over The Blues, who had Jhon Solis sent off for a second yellow card following the goals. Hear from the Head Coach below as he discusses the reaction to Saturday's fixture against Portsmouth, an update on Caleb Taylor and much more.

item.title: Preview | Charlton Athletic v Millwall Under 21s
item.description: Millwall Under 21s travel to Sparrows Lane to take on Charlton Athletic in the Professional Development League on Friday afternoon (kick-off 1.30pm). The Young Lions go into this match with two wins, a draw and two defeats from the last five.
